newsitem.title: CHINA: China opens oil pipeline in northwest Xinjiang.
newsitem.headline: China opens oil pipeline in northwest Xinjiang.

text.p: A pipeline to move crude oil out of the Tarim Basin in China's northwestern Xinjiang region has gone into operation, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The 476-km pipeline connects the major oil-producing city of Korla in the west to the Shanshan oilfield in the east and can handle five million to 10 million tonnes of oil a year, Xinhua said.
The section that opened on Tuesday was the first part of a much longer line that will ultimately reach southwestern Sichuan province and central Henan province, Xinhua said.
